summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 actual characters and at least three character classes. The policy persisted through the mandatory reboot and passed direct post-restart enforcement tests.
actions_performed: Set all class credits to zero so minlen enforces literal character count on RHEL 7.
Verified PAM uses pam_pwquality for system-auth and password-auth.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed recovery under a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Minimum password length is 12 actual characters
evidence.summary: Configuration sets minlen=12 with length credits disabled; an 11-character four-class password was rejected before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Passwords require at least three character classes
evidence.summary: A 12-character two-class password was rejected, while a 12-character four-class password was accepted.

Healthy baseline used boot ID b35fad86-4e61-46bf-bbd2-0dadcedb685d; safe reboot was acknowledged; execution returned with boot ID 99a3d3e1-5efb-4971-8a0b-60e1f1ecf6be; sshd, PAM integration, persisted configuration, and enforcement all recovered.
